body: Center precision is J^(e-h), not a fictitious exact full-ring center. Pure ordinary squares become binary-linear under the primitive trace; squarefree cubic coefficients stay frozen from the third tensor. h=e has a zero-dimensional center solve, not a length-zero ring. Acquiring such a representation does not establish a finite or nondegenerate critical locus; the archived rank-five counterexample is separate.
